tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs lam dus sogs sgrub thabs kyi tshogs 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i nyer mkho ngo mtshar can 'di rnams la bar skabs su yi ge'i lhag chad cung zad byung ba'i dpe 'ga' zhig snang ba las/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa chen po'i sgo nas zhus dag bgyis pa dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams kyi yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na ma shrī bhu mi gu ru bha dra ya/ ma nor lam gyi nges gsang bla na med/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i dgongs don snying po'i bcud/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu stsol ba'i rtsi sman mchog /ston mdzad brgyud pa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma kun 'dus byin rlabs rin chen gter/ /mtshan tsam thos pas dga' bde'i dpal bskyed cing / /dran pa'i mod la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub stsol mdzad rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /mi dbang rnam dpyod rab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter/ /ngo mtshar yid ches 'bras bzang nam mkha'i mdzod/ /chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /lha sras gang gi bzhed mtsho gang gyur cig /dgyes mdzad rgyud kyi bla ma gnyis med tshul/ /tshul bzhin shes pa'i blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sde tshan brtag gnyis las/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rgyud/ /de ni nga yi bshad kyi nyon/ /zhes pa'i tshig zur la brten nas gnyis med rgyud du bzhag gong ma'i gsung bgros/ sil bu'i sa skya'i thugs mdzod las/ /las dkar thun bzhi'i ngag 'don 'di spel to/ /'dir chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ des na grub thob thams cad kyang / /phyogs re'i thabs rtsa rlung thig le phra mo sogs/ kyis grol ba min/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i/

/ye shes rtogs nas rang byung gzung 'dzin las/ grol ba yin/ /zhes dang / bskyed rim rlung dang gtum mo sogs/ /rim pa gnyis las tha dad min/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i nang gi rten 'brel gyi rim gnyis/ de las byung ba yin/ /lta ba gnas lugs ma log pa'i/ de yi yan lag yin/ /phyag bzhi don ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i/ rgya chen po'ang de'i ye shes/ /zhes brtag gnyis las/ chu bo'i rgyun 'dir rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyi/ /nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i don ltar/ pa'i nges gsang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la nye bar sbyor ba'i tshul bla ma'i zhal las rnyed pa 'di bsnyad cing bstan te/ de'ang rje btsun sku mched kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi drug so so dang / khyad par rje btsun rin po ches lam 'bras/ glegs bam du yan lag drug pa nyid la 'dor len mdzad/ rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan dang mthun pa'i phyi bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag nges pa kho nar/ nang lus dkyil dang 'brel pa can du bshad pa'i ngag 'don bsgom pa dang 'brel pa yang / mdang thun mig dang po 'di nas 'dzin/ nub mo rang bzhin lhan skyes rnam par mi rtog pa blos byas kyi stong gsal slod pa'i ngang de nyid las dbyings mthar thug las ye shes kyi tshul lam/ skye gnas skabs/ ba snga ma'i 'chi srid las/ /bar rang nyid nges 'byung gi srid pa/ ma do'i gnas 'dzin pa'i sbyang gzhi dang sbyar nas rang nyid dgyes mdzad brgyad pa'i zhal can/ bcu drug gi phyag can/ nyer bzhi'i spyan can/ zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa'i pang na yum khyab bdag stong ma/ nai ra rma stong gsal nam mkha'i bdag mo bde chen ye shes kyi spyod yul gyis 'khyud pa'i 'khril sbyor bde ba chen po 'pho ba'i bag chags dang bral ba'i rang bzhin gnyug grub chen mtsho skyes kyis/

thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rje zhes pa'i dbang las so/ /ma'i lha/ mi shigs pa'i gzhol med rtag pa'i gsang gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i nges la drangs nas/ zung brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus la ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rgyud don bsgom du 'chad pa'o/ /'jug la zung 'jug gi rgya dang ldan pa'i dad pa ma log pa sngar bla ma'i drin las skyes brtag pa gnyis pa las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs rten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /pa'i myong ba dang 'brel pa'i rang babs la ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag cing 'jog mkhan gyi shes pa rang grol rgya yan lhug pa ste/ ma bsdams pa'i gnad kyis ma yengs tsam du ma bzla zhing brtag gnyis las/ de mthar snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i snang ba ji snyed pa mtha' yas pa yang / sman pa mkhas pa nags su zhugs pa'i dpe/ rtswa thams cad kyang sman gyi rol par shes pa'i/ gzhal yas khang dang rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i snang brnyan sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bkod pa las thob pa'i dran pa nyag gcig gi rang snang ma bcos pa'i rnam rol las gud du ma lus pa'i spyir snang lha dang ye shes la nges pa brtan pos/ sngar dbang bskur zhing lam ston pa'i drin can rdo rje sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun de/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /zhes pa'i dbang las so/ /sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas su nges pa'i yid ches dang bcas/ sa paṇa gyi gsung la dmar gyi man ngag gi tshig bcad las/ lus kyi spyod lam rab bsgrims nas/

/sems kyi dmigs pa rtse gcig 'grub/ /drod dang bde ba myur du bskyed/ /byang rgod sel ba'i thabs su gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon nyid dkyil 'khor bdag po'i rnam par dran pas dad pa gsum stobs su gyur pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ci nas kyang 'brel pa kho na'i rtse gcig pa'i lus ngag yid gsum lhan du sbyar te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /long skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'jug pa sel ba'i lam du 'gyur nges bgyis pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying khar sbyar zhing 'dud pa dang bcas bla ma sdom gsum las/ gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin/ /de bas de la gsol btab na/ /dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub/ /ces pa'i bsgom don no/ /dang dkon mchog rin po che rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi bla ma dang skyabs yul gyi snang cha gsal stong bde chen gnas su byas nas rang nyid la thim pa'i snang cha la brten mos pa nyid lam du byed pa'i thabs mkhas kyis drangs rang gi lus dge 'dun/ ngag chos/ sems sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu shes pa'i yid bde dang lhan cig tu don gyi yi ge 'pho ba med pa'i/

nas/ byin rlabs lam byed rang las logs gzhan zhig tu skyabs yul rgyang chad du gyur pa'i gegs las ngang gis log nas/ dkon mchog dang dbyer med du shar ba'i skyabs gnas kun 'dus la yid ches pa'i dad 'dun 'dzin med rang yan du bskyangs/ 'gro rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don dang / /phyi rol gyur pa'ang cung zad med/ /ces ci snang sems su shes pa'i khyad par las rang gi mtshang rig pa'o/ /kha che paṇa chen gyi gsung rgyun sa paṇa man mdzad/ rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi'o/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyis/ /la sogs pa sems bskyed bsdus pa yin pa nges par/ gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje snyem ma gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pas brgyan pa'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ da lta kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol zer na'ang ma dag ku ru mam̐ zhes mdzod cig pa'o/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyongs/ /he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍ-i ḍadho bdag la brtan par mdzod/

me bha wa/ su bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhi m+me bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ pra yats+tshan/ sarba las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta taṃ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ shrī yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung gi ga wān badz+ra he ru ka ma bdag ni he ru ka grol mdzod/ me muñtsa he ru kau3bha wa ma hā dam tshig sems dpa' chen po ā/ zhes gsungs/ sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ dam tshig /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rang skad cig gis kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/

/byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan par gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug du/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig

sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ pad nyi'i steng du bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa rtse mo rno ba/ khog stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rum̐ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ 'khor lo'i dbus dang phyogs bcur pad nyi re re'i dbus su bh+rum̐/ phyogs bcur hūm̐ re re las dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo/ shar du gshin rje sngon po tho ba/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri/ shar lhor 'dod rgyal sngon po lcags kyu/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa/ nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing / g.yon rnams thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi brjid khro mtshams bzhi mdzes khro/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus g.yon brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i cod pan can du gsal pa'i dpral mgrin snying gar gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig srung 'khor dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

de nas lus bsrung zhing ming sba bar bya ste/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas gtams par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa/ de'i lte ba stong par yod pa'i nang du rang gi sems hūm̐ gcig tu bsgom/ de'i steng la sogs par gang bsrung bar 'dod pa'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsam ste/ de yang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na steng du/ spun zla g.yon du/ pha ma mdun du/ bu dang chung ma g.yas su/ 'khor g.yog rgyab tu/ nor rdzas rnams 'og tu bsam/ gang mi bsrung ba'i sa stong par bzhag go /de nas 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs med pa'i bar du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgrub bya lus rid cing skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'dug par bsam/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ gnod byed kyi shes pa bkug la bsgrub bya de nyid la bstim mo/ /de nas rang gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyangs su bsgyur/ 'khor lo g.yon 'khor du myur bar 'khor bas/ gnod byed kyi lus rlung gis bskyod/ mes bsregs shing 'khor lo'i rtse mos nyal nyal du gtub par bsam mo/ /de ltar gtubs pas kho'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas rnam par shes pa mi skyod pa'i zhing du skyel bar bsam zhing sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas sangs rgyas la/ na maḥs phyag 'tshal kun nas chos la/ man+ta dharmā ṇam̐/ na maḥ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas dge 'dun la/ sa man+ta sam̐ gha nām̐/ oṃ si tā gdung skyobs dkar po/

ta pa tre/ oṃ bi dri ma med pa/ ma la/ oṃ shang ka ra/ bde bar zhi ba'am zhi bar byed pa/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ phyir bzlog pa/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra wa ti/ rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ sarba yan+ta/ 'khrul 'khor thams cad/ man+t+ra/ gsang sngags/ mū la karma/ rtsa ba'i las/ ban+dha 'ching ba/ naṃ/ ki la bāṃ wā/ phur bus 'debs pa/ ma ma kṛ te/ bdag gir byed pa/ ye na ke na tsi ta/ gang su yang rung ba/ kri tan+t+ra ta/ sems kyi/ byas pa de/ sarban+tu/ thams cad ni/ ts+tshin+dha/ btub gnyis/ ts+tshin+dha/ bin+dha bin+dha/ phye phye/ tsi ri tsi ri/ phye bar gyis phye bar gyis/ gi ri gi ri/ non non/ ma ra ma ra/ sod sod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ khro bo bcu'i sa bon/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ khos khos khos/ ces pa lan bdun nam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzla bar bya'o/ /gang dag bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcings bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phral brlag par༞ stobs brlag༞ des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par༞ des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha la bza' bar gyur cig khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas par bsam ste/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/

/gtsug thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor khro bo bcu dang rang la thim rang nyid/ tor zhu ba las gzhi'i yan lag e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/ yaṃ rlung / ram̐ me/ bam̐ chu/ lam̐ sa/ bh+rūm̐ 'khor lo/ rnams las 'byung ba bzhi ri rab dang / rang gi sems snang ho oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che dag pa'i zhing sbyong ba'i gnad yin pas rnam pa gsal ba nyid gtso che'o/ /sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa/ mtshan do shal dang do shal phyed/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can sogs/ nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi dur khrod chen po brgyad shing / phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / sprin/ chu me/ mchod rten/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo brgyad brgyad gnas pa'o/ /kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang gi lha rnams phyogs mdog tu gnas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa/ dkar/ lhor dbang po/ ser/ nub tu nye dbang / sngo/ byang du drag po/ nag byang shar du gshin rje/ sngo/ shar ser/ lhor nor bdag lho nag nub tu srin po/ nub byang du thag bzang dud kha/ ris rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang skad cig gis rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/

yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i āḥlas byung ba'i yum gyi pad+ma dang hūm̐ las byung ba'i yab kyi rdo rje āḥdang hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma bde ba 'dzin pa ni/ pad+ma su khā dha rā/ mahā ra ga su 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba ste/ khan+da da/ tsa dga' ba bzhi bskal pa sna tshogs pa/ tur gan+da/ bha ga wi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kar+yaṃ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o/ /ku ru ṣ+ṭha me/ oṃ rdo rje zhe sdang chen po ni/ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa/ tsa dga' ba bzhi ni ster bar byed/ tu rā nan+da dā ya ka kha mkha' 'gro'i gdong pa ro gcig mgon/ ga mu kha e kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kar+yaṃ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o/ /ku ru ṣa me/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rnams spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi mkhar babs pa sa bon gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ bam̐ sham̐ yam̐ ṭam̐/ brgyad du gyur pa dbang gi gnas nas phyir 'phros/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gam̐ las go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsam̐ las tsau ri ta dmar mo g.yas cang te'u dang / g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bam̐ las bet+ta li ser mo g.yas rus sbal dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gham̐ las ghasmā ri ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pam̐ las pu ka si sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor sham̐ las sha ba ri dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon bsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu bam̐ las gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ṭam̐ las g.yung mo sna tshogs mdog g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pas gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras bar do'i rnam par yi ge brtsegs pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' rten pa'i/ shes pa bkug yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gyi thig dbyings las ye shes kyi rgyas 'debs/ ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i phyir glus bskul ba ni/ rang gi shes pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhir 'phos nas bskul bar bsam ste/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /kyai rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin gyis spongs la/ /ri khrod snying rjes/ ma 'bras 'grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol dga' ba/ pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gi khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung btang snyoms/ mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas thig le de hūm̐ aṃ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de las bcom ldan 'das 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa/

g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa/ zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po/ dkar po/ rta/ sngo/ bong ga pa/ glang / ser/ rnga mo/ thal ka mi dmar po/ sha ra bha/ sngon po/ byi la/ ga pa/ g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa dang / ser/ chu dang / dkar/ me dang / dmar/ rlung / ljang / zla dkar po/ nyi dmar/ gshin rje sngon po/ nor ser/ sbyin rnams bsnams pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i cod pan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs su bzhugs pa/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med pa sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ yum dang lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ snod gzhal yas khang / bcud lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ de thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma/ dkar mo/ rna bar dam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sngon mo rje ma/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma/ ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma/ ljang khu/ snying khar nam las bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma/ dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma/ dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdungs/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces brjod pas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can gsad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /oṃ badz+ra gau lag pa lcags kyu phyag rgya bca'/ ri ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra lcags sgrog tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bait+ta li ban+dha zhags pa/ bam̐/ oṃ badz+ra dril bu'i phyag rgya/ ghasma rī wa sham̐ ku ru hoḥganyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsibs ma rdo rje'i ra ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ skra sen mo me ris 'bar ba ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ rgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus ma mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re kha'i rtsig pa/

sna rin chen pha gu/ so dra ba dra phyed/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ lte ba sprul 'khor rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar/ am̐ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i gzhung bshad lung sbyor gnyis ka las 'di ltar 'byung / las rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gsang gnas bde skyong rtsa 'dab so gnyis kyi lte bar ha las don grub ljang / yab yum/ snying kha chos 'khor rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa yab yum/ sngon po/ mgrin pa longs spyod rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi lte bar oṃ las 'od dpag med yab yum/ spyi bo bde chen rtsa 'dab so gnyis kyi lte bar haṃ las rnam snang yab yum/ dkar po/ dug lnga gnas su dag cing ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gzugs su shar ba mtshan dpes brgyan zhing 'byung lnga dag pa'i shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum mtshungs kyi lha mo rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam pas bskor ba/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ mig gnyis su gzugs kyi rang bzhin go rī/ rna bar sgra'i rang bzhin tsau rī/ snar dri'i rang bzhin bet+ta lī/ lcer ro'i rang bzhin ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying kar chos khams mkha' spyod ma/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje gshed/ g.yon par shes rab mthar byed/ khar pad+ma mthar byed/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed/ dpung mgo g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes/ lha de thams cad sku dbyibs bum dbang / rnam pa bde ba/ gsang dbang / rang bzhin shes rab ye shes/

gsal stong / ngo bo zung 'jug bzhi pa/ gzhan yang lus rtsa drug sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi skur gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ mi bskyod pa sogs/ yum bzhi/ sangs rgyas spyan ma sogs/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ byams pa sogs/ khro bo bcu/ gshin rje'i gshed sogs/ lha mo drug gzugs rdo rje ma sogs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod la/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ /bkod legs mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshad med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa la rig pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs dang bcas zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyobs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha:sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa las yum ma mā ki gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can du gsal ba'i dpral mgrin snying kar gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/

sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las bum chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye hūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3ham̐/ bdag gi tshor phung dang dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum rin chen sgrol ma gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rin 'byung gi cod pan can du gsal ba'i dpral mgrin snying khar gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa badz+ra rak+ta badz+ra sha li ho/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag

oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag gi 'du shes dang rdo rje mi dmigs te dziṃ las pad+ma dziṃ gis mtshan pa las/ snang mtha' dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nas gyur gyi bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ de ltar na snang mtha'i sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag swa bhā wa/ bdag gi 'du byed dang dril bu mi dmigs te/ kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa las/ don grub ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nas gyur gyi bar dang / de bzhin sogs/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha wī ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ de ltar don grub kyi sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du gyur/ don grub kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag swa bhā wa/ bdag gi gzugs phung mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas spyan gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī ran+ta badz+ra zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe/ de ltar na rnam snang gi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs phung gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang gi bag chags rgyud la bzhag dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/

/chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med par/ /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /swa bhā wa/ chos can phung po lnga'i chos nyid dbyings kyi cha mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum snyems ma gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can du gsal ba'i dpral mgrin snying khar gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdor sems kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'adi de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka satwam̐ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ bkod legs mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon gong ma'i dbang dang bcas pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi sogs/ mi bzlog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su bzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa bla na med pa stsol/ /gsum/ rang nyid dbang stegs dang pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje 'chang sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i g.yas su rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig g.yon du dril bu gsung gi dam tshig pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo bcu drug lon pas 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/

rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / /bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rkang mthil yan chad gang / mchog tu bde ba bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pas dbang bskur bas lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ho mahā su kha/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zungs shig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyed la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas yid kyi dri ma dag lam pho nya'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyed rang yang ni de yi pha/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang rin po che bzhi pa bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /gsum/ bkod legs mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa la dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i bka' drin du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni dbul lags kyis/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /gsum/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum/ gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bait+ta lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ swa bhā wa༞ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yi ge zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ oṃ sarba ta mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ khyod ni sogs/ oṃ sarba bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ 'dir gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa bsgom nas/

snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyi ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum mo/ /sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod/ /de ni khrag ni ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /lpags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa dben pa bzhi po nyid/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ske rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /aṣ+ṭa/ de wa pi tsu/ rnal 'byor ma'i phreng sngags/ lha mo so so'i sngags rnams ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim/ kol+la i ri ṭaṭhi sogs/ rigs su skye dang sogs/ ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta/ 'gro ba thams cad kye rdo rje sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag ces thun mthar ngo bo nyid kyi lta ba yun ring bskyangs shing / kha zas kyi tshe zas snod thod pa/ bcud dam tshig bdud rtsir mos la/ shub bur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod la byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang lhar gsal ba'i lus dkyil ma lus pa gsal btab nas/ snying kha'i thugs rdo rje'i mi bskyod pa dang bla ma gnyis su med par mos la/ kha hoṃ khung / lag pa gnyis dgang gzar blug zas ye shes kyi me'i nang gi bsreg blug tu bya zhing /

gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu 'khor 'das dbyer med las skad cig kyang ma 'das pa'i ngang nyid las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod mtha' dag la mi zhen/ mi sdang ba'i rnam par rol pa nyid kyi nyams len rjes su bsgrub pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po de nyid kyis glo bo dge sbyong a ma dpal la smar khrid mdzub tshugs su gnang ba'i tshig rigs ma nyams pa ji lta ba bzhin du yi ger bkod pa la yid gnyis dang the tshom gyi kun rtog gi rnyog ma gang gis kyang nam yang reg par mi bya zhing / gnad bsdus kyi snying po 'di'i dpe tsam yang 'khyar ba ci nas kyang gsang zhing sba bar bya'o/ /rgyal mchog chos kyi rje yis gdul bya'i ngor/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir btags pa'i/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gnad kyi sgo mang po/ /dus gcig nyid la rjes su 'dom par mdzad/ /lung bstan brnyes pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed brgyas/ /ji lta'i gnas la sgrib thogs med bzhin du/ /ji snyed brjod pa'i tshig 'bru gsal ldan pa'i/ /rnam grangs bye ba'i gzhung lugs dpag yas bskrun/ /'di nyid mthu chen bir+wa'i rjes 'jug pa'i/ /sa skya'i bla chen thugs mtsho las 'ong ba'i/ /rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan mchog bzang po des/ /skal ldan snying la babs pa'i gsang chos yin/ /tshig nyung bzung bde ngag snyoms mkhas pa'i tshig /don zab rgya che'i snying por dril ba'i don/ /bshad pa 'di ni bsnyon med gong mas bshad/ /yin lugs mchan bur bkod pa ji bzhin yin/ /rgyud don snang ba'i nyin byed dang 'brel zhing / /rgya bod mkhas grub 'od stong bye ba brgyas/ /'dren byed thun bzhi'i shing rtas nyer drangs tshe/ /lugs ngan mun pa'i smag rum lan brgyar bsal/ /'chad mkhas ngag tshig 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo'i glu/ /nyan shes rab grim rna ba'i lam zhugs nas/ /don bzang yid ches snying la brnags pa'i cha/

/ldan tshul gzur gnas kun gyis bde blag shes/ /thos pa'i dpung tshogs yan lag rnam bzhi'i tshogs/ /pa sangs rgyu skar bye bas dper min cha ston pa'i legs bshad kyi tshogs/ ltar/ /don bzhin ha cang ma spos nyams len bcud/ /yod med rtag chad sgro 'dogs g.yul las rgyal/ /mkhas pa dag bsam bsgom mthar phyung bar byas nas/ mdo rgyud ma lus kun/ gyi/ /snying po 'dus pa'am don bsdus kyi/ rab dang mchog ces smra ba bzhin/ /don la ston pa'i sdeb legs dam pa'i gsung / /'grub 'gyur dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas nyid/ /'dir ni rang bzo'i ngan rtog dri ma'i rgyun/ /yid dpyod phra mos sbags pa'i gnas med de/ /mi brjed gzungs kyi ting 'dzin cha tsam gyis/ /bdag blo yongs su gang bas snyems pas brjod/ /ka ye mi shes mun pa'i mal stan la/ /lo brgya brtan pa'i yus can sdug btsir ba/ /blun po sbyangs pas mnar ba'i log shes kyis/ /mngon rlom spyi rdol can gyi 'gran zla min/ /rab 'byams mdo sngags dgongs 'grel mkhas pa'i gzhung / /kun la'ang gcig la sbyangs 'dra'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /shes ldan snying gi shing rta 'dren pa la/ /'dri na ngang gi rang snang 'byor ba lags/ /de ltar smra ba'i rang bzhin drang po'i mda'/ /brdzun med bden pa'i gzhu mo la sbyar nas/ /chen por rlom pa'i mi shes gyi na'i tshang / /lan gcig bsnun pa'i mod la'ang 'jig gyur cig /ces dam pa'i chos la rjes su dgongs pa'i legs byas dang lhan cig bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i sa skyong mi'i dbang po'i bka' khur spyi bor blangs nas/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sdes ji lta'i don ji bzhin du bris pa'o// ༈ //kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs nyung gsal gnad bsdus ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/

/sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o/ /rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po/ de'i 'od kyis rang bzhin nas bla ma dang kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad lan gsum/ sems can thams cad nas/ tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig shu n+yā ta/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung la gnas pa'i srung 'khor/ gzhal yas khang dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan dang / phyogs bzhir tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang / drag po/ mtshams bzhir gshin rje/ nor bdag srin po/ thag bzang ris rnams gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i dbus kyi steng du rang nyid hūm̐ dang aṃ las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du gsal ba'i hūm̐ las yab kyi rdo rje dang / aṃ las yum gyi pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ gsang gnas su gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ sa bon brgyad du gyur pa so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī/ lhor tso rī/ nub tu bait+ta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo rnams rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ kha dog rgyan cha lugs/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i gtso bo yab yum gyi bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu ba'i thig ler gyur/ rje btsun nas/ ma mdzad cig

thig le hūm̐ aṃ sngon po 'od 'bar ba las/ rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po/ rta/ bong / glang / rnga mo/ mi/ sha ra wa/ byi la/ g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung / zla/ nyi/ gshin rje/ nor 'dzin dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma/ gzhan so so'i thugs kar zla bar gnas pa'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud lha dgur gyur pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje/ snar ser sna rdo rje/ khar 'dod chags rdo rje/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje/ snying khar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi mgrin snying gar rdo rje ma gsum dang bcas pa'i snying kha'i 'od zer gyis kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo/ khyod ni/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī nas/ ku ru hoḥganyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang gi lus skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje sogs dang / srung 'khor/ rkang mthil rlung sogs 'byung bzhi'i lus gzhal yas khang mig sogs kyi rnam par shar ba'i lte gsang / snying / mgrin/ spyi bo ste gnas lngar so so'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su aṃ hūm̐ oṃ haṃ las/ dug lnga dag pa ye shes lnga rang bzhin rgyal ba rigs lnga/ 'byung lnga dag pa'i yum rnams dang mnyam par sbyor zhing / yum 'dra'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sum cu so gnyis/ brgyad/ bcu drug so gnyis rnams kyis bskor ba/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /mig la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su gti mug rdo rje sogs yul gyi lha mo drug

gau ri sogs gzhan yul can lha mo drug yan lag gi tshigs mtshams rnams su khro bo'i dbang po bcu dang bcas pa'i sku dbyibs rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal stong / ngo bo zung 'jug rtsa yi ge rlung thig le/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdakar mo zhe sdang rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi sogs nas/ rdo rje che dang nas/ bsdu bar gyis bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob sogs nas/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs nas/ dga' ster sogs/ ye shes sogs nas/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag gtso bos sogs/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum nas lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum re res dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ khyod ni nas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyi dgyes/ /'khor lo bzhi dang 'brel ba bsgom/ /snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /nas/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa sogs/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri sogs/ oṃ āḥ.a a/ sogs nas/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sogs nas/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung ram̐ las me a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gsum/ snying kha'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung sum brtsegs la gnas pa'i kyai rdo rje lha dgu/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lha tshogs/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wa ra ka ya waka tsit+ta sa mā dzaḥ gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya nas/ ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru ho ni ri na wi te sogs/ oṃ in+da nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar mo/ khyod ni/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīṃḥ/ snying kha'i 'od kyis 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo/ ti si/ bsil ba tshal/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas dpal ldan mgon po zhal bzhi pa/ rdo rje gdan gyi spo nas las mgon pho nya/ yul nyer bzhi/ gnas so gnyis/ dur khrod brgyad nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya mahā kā la de wi tsa tu ra mu kha karma nā tha sa pa ri wā ra/ e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ aṃ sogs/ oṃ shrī nā tha wī ra ḍā ki sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ka li de wi/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi ka la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍom+bhi ni tsaṇ+ḍa li rak+ka si siṅga li de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ kha khā sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de wa lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i mam̐ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ gsum/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/

thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /nas/ kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi thugs ni sogs/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /sogs/ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing / /sogs dang / dpal ldan 'phrin las kun rdzogs pu tra khyod/ /sogs/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /sogs/ rnal 'byor bdag cag mi shes bag med cing / /ma gus le lo'i dbang du gyur pa dang / /bsgom bzlas mchod dang gtor 'bul g.yel ba sogs/ /bdag gi dam tshig nyams chag bskang gyur cig /khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /sogs dang / kaul+la i ri/ phun sum tshogs pa/ rigs su skye/ yig brgya/ ma 'byor pa dang / bdag gi mig tu gti mug nas/ /thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta 'gro ba thams cad kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /kyai rdo rje 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /nyung gsal ma tshang med pa'i tshul/ /tshul 'di brgyud pa'i gsung bgros ltar/ /ltar snang ma 'dres zab mo'i gnad/ /gnad bsdus 'di ni bdag gis bsdebs/ /zhes btsun pa grol mchog blo gros kyi 'phrul las byung ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' bzod pa'o// ༈ //lam zab chag med gnad bsdus ni/ skyabs 'gro sngar bzhin/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri pad nyi bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la bla ma dang kyai rdo rje dbyer med pa/ sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i phung po lnga ni rigs lnga/

'byung ba bzhi ni yum/ nang gi skye mched bzhi ni sems dpa'/ phyi'i skye mched ni sems ma/ tshigs chen rnams ni khro bo khro mo/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhar gyur pa'i mthar/ brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang / chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gang gi drin gyis nas/ dpal la 'dud/ /bdag gi lus longs spyod bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o/ /nyon mongs dug gsum dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥthod pa'i nang gi rang lus kyi dum bu rnams bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yul ma lus pa mnyes/ bla ma'i dpral mgrin snying kha nas/ yi ge 'bru gsum 'od zer bdud rtsi zung 'brel du byung nas/ dbang bzhi thob/ bla ma rang la thim/ dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o/ /bkra shis// ༈ //bir bsrung chag med gnad bsdus ni/ skyabs 'gro sngar bzhin/ bir bsrung zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la/ grub chen bir+wa pa sku mdog sngo nag gaṅgā gyen bzlog 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyi thod bcings dang cod pan can/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i sems dpa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ grub chen bir+wa pas bdag gi rgyud la byin gyis rlobs shig oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu le badz+ra ka pa li/ badz+ra dh+wi ni bar+dhu ha ra/ badz+ra pi waṃ hu tsam khe sa ra bhe da na/ kha ge e/ aṃ ge mi li/ legs par ta/ ta 'u la ri pa ṭa/ aṃ bhi ru wa sa ra na/ na mo dha ni/ wa ra ṇa/ chu bo chen po gyen la bzlog /chang la nyi ma gteng par bcug /bir+wa pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang la bstim la/ bsrung bar bya bar/ rlung lan gnyis 'bud pa dang phyag rgya lus dben la reg cing sngags yid kyis brjod de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas bdag gi bar chad bzlog tu gsol/

dge'o// ༈ //rnal 'byor ma chag med bsdus pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngar bzhin la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ /spyi bo'i pad zla'i steng du bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ de rang la thim pas/ snying khar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ sdig sgrib bsregs nas 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig la rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wam̐ ga 'dzin pa/ pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i/ gnas gsum du zla ba'i gdan la/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ oṃ hrīṃ moṃ hreṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ pheṃ/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoṃ: oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dag pa'i dbyings su khrid par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs chag med bzhi/ kyai rdor gur zhal sogs kyi gtor bsngo dang bcas pa 'di dag ni/ lugs gnyis kyi bya bas brel ba dang / nad drag pos nyer len chag par thug nas rgyas pa stobs kyis bsgrub ma nus pa ma gtogs/ gzhan ngag gis bag yangs byar mi rung ba'i bka' rgya cher dam par yod pa na/ bsrung dor ma 'dzol ba mdzad du gsol/ ces lam zab/ bir bsrungs/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi nyams len gnad bsdus 'di dag kyang dge slong bsod snyoms pa kun dga' grol mchog gi blo mtsho las so/ /'dir smras pa/ tshul 'di mang thos gzur gnas rnam dpyod can/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi zab mo'i don/

/gting nas go ba'i mkhas pa'i mchog /re re tsam la mkho ba'i bstan bcos te/ /gzhan du yun ring sbyangs pa'i sdug yus can/ /tshig shes mang yang zab gnad rtogs pa la/ /blo mig bral ba'i mkhas rlom phal cher dang / /ri bong cal rgyug byed pa'i blun po'i tshogs/ /de dag rnams kyis mthong yang ci bya yod/ /de skad 'di na dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i sngags 'chang a nan+das/ /de phyir skal bzang rnams kyis rtogs phyir smras/ /gong ma'i gsang ba'i yi ge 'di/ /bdag gis gsang gros tshul gyis bris/ /rjes 'jug gsang tshig thub rnams kyis/ /rab tu gsang la nyams su longs/ /sems dang 'brel ba'i chos thams cad/ /nyams len yin no tshig mang yang / /shes pa yangs pa'i ngag 'don de/ /don med ne tso'i 'don pa 'dra/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 26 a myes zhabs/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs lam dus sogs sgrub thabs kyi tshogs rnams la zhus dag bgyis pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 25
